patronOf.pt-BR: A paz dada uns aos outros

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The peace of the Lord be with you always. And with your spirit.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A paz do Senhor esteja sempre convosco. O amor de Cristo nos uniu.

meta.basis: After the prayer for peace the priest, turned to the people, gives the greeting of the excerpt; then 'all express to one another peace, communion, and charity', each 'in a sober manner' offering it 'only to those who are nearest', in the form set by the Conference of Bishops; the priest gives it to the ministers but 'always remains within the sanctuary' (GIRM 154, 82; the Order of Mass rubric). The handshake with a bow is the usual form in the US and in Brazil; the people stand (GIRM 43).
